app.name: PhoneMail
app.tagline: Your phone number is your email address.

portal.subtitle: Your phone number becomes your email address.
portal.phoneHint: Outside India? Start with + and your country code.
portal.codeLocked: Send a code to your phone first.
portal.successBody: {{address}} is ready. Sign in on the PhoneMail app or on the web to read your email.
portal.resetting: This form clears in a few seconds for the next person.

demo.banner: Demo mode: codes and SMS are not really sent. They show up here instead.
demo.feedEmpty: Nothing sent yet. Register a number and its code appears here.
demo.off: The demo console is only available in demo mode.
demo.sendHint: It travels over real SMTP (port 2525) from an outside address, the way mail from Gmail would.

errors.NETWORK: Can't reach PhoneMail. Check your connection.
errors.ALREADY_REGISTERED: This number already has a PhoneMail address. Sign in instead.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.OTP_INVALID: That code isn't right. Tries left: {{attemptsLeft}}.
errors.OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait {{seconds}} seconds and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_SOON: Too many tries. Wait a little and try again.
errors.OTP_UNAVAILABLE: Codes are switched off right now.
errors.SMS_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't send an SMS right now. Try again soon.
errors.PASSWORD_NOT_SET: This account signs in with a code.
errors.PASSWORD_LOGIN_DISABLED: Sign in with a code sent by SMS.
errors.SESSION_REVOKED: For your safety, please sign in again.
errors.ALIAS_INVALID: Use 3–30 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter.
errors.ALIAS_HELD: Someone used that name recently. Try another.
errors.ALIAS_LIMIT: You can have up to 5 aliases.
